g.text: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash answering 48 doctor and patient questions over synthetic clinic records, as the store grows from 40k to 800k tokens.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #898781

g.text: Full prompt = whole store in the prompt, with prompt caching. Embeddings = semantic search tool (bge-base, top 8). Markdown index = file index in the prompt, files read on demand.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #898781

g.text: Quality graded fact by fact by a blinded LLM grader (NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super); no quality difference is statistically significant (Wilcoxon, Holm). Cost = actual OpenRouter charges (DeepInfra). All patients are synthetic.
